paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: BLEU comparison between original Consistency-CE model and ours proposed Consistency-Bi model for wait-1 testing under prefix-constrained decoding setting.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the BLEU scores of two models—Consistency-CE (blue, dashed line with circle markers) and Consistency-Bi (orange, solid line with square markers)—as a function of the length of the gold prefix, ranging from 0 to 20. The x-axis, labeled “the length of gold prefix,” is linearly scaled with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” ranges from 23 to 29, with horizontal gridlines at integer values. The Consistency-CE model begins at approximately BLEU 25.0 at prefix length 0, dips to 23.8 at length 1, then generally increases to 28.1 at length 20. In contrast, the Consistency-Bi model starts at BLEU 27.7, remains relatively stable until prefix length 5 (around 28.0), then declines steadily to 24.0 at length 20. The two lines intersect near prefix length 12, where both models score approximately 26.0. The legend in the lower right identifies the two models with their respective line styles and colors.
